findings.sol-11/astra-6 guard breadth: Guarded paths still include globs lib/kogen/build/**, lib/kogen/harness/**, test/kogen/**, test/support/**. Package rationale: the running controller's lib code is already compiled into memory; the only lazy-load hazard is a dev-env recompile, which the Developer notes forbid; the files the running controller reads from disk at run time (.codex/hooks*, priv/kogen/claude_code/settings.json, prompts, Makefile, catalog, config) are all excluded and asserted byte-identical by scenario controller-judges-candidate; exact enumeration would miss module names created by the earlier Intents #1 and #4 and cause guard violations.
findings.sol-13/astra-9 size: Ten scenarios, four new test files, catalog source_sha256 refresh for edited tests, one paid lifecycle target. Evidence: the previous attempt of the same Intent (61 files, +4330 lines, including hook/Stop work now removed) passed check and both paid targets and failed only on a review finding and a self-hosting hook rewrite that this revision forbids. A fallback split (Candidate commands as a follow-up) is documented.
findings.astra-4 Claude sanitization: Revised: Claude launches now also remove CODEX_, OPENAI_, AZURE_, CHATGPT_ prefixes and replace inherited CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR, asserted in the child-process environment.
findings.new-1 bootstrap circularity: The installing Build runs under then-main without workspace admission; the package states this explicitly and proves the new code only through tests and the paid fixture Build that runs the Candidate's code.
findings.new-2 paid prerequisite: The package assumes cross-harness-adversarial-roles has landed (default route Reviewer on Codex); revised wording makes the paid observation route-agnostic: the default route's Reviewer harness, whichever it is, must record the Candidate cwd.
